changelog: Sort the Orders list by tapping a column heading — Customer, Job No, Date, Due, Status, Total or Balance. Tapping the same heading again turns the order round, and the sort stays put while you filter.
Tick boxes on every row. Pick the ones you want and a bar appears: Print selected, or Selected to Excel. Shift-click ticks a whole run of rows at once, and Select all takes the page in one go.

New Excel button: the list you are looking at comes down as a spreadsheet — job no, customer, phone, contact person, dates, status, items, designer, who took it, priority, total, paid, discount, balance and note. Money is written as plain numbers so Excel can add it up.
The Orders list now shows what the whole filtered set comes to — total and balance due — under the table, not just the page you are on.

Fixed: "Still pending (not delivered)" meant one thing on the screen and another on the printed sheet, so the two did not match. The screen, the sheet and the Excel file now read the filter in exactly one place and always agree.
A Clear button next to Filter puts the list back to normal in one tap.
